SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_id, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS dist_rl, sum(f.net_amount) AS net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 9
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2

SELECT fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date, weeks_in_period, fully_loaded FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 9 ORDER BY fiscal_period

SELECT s.store_id, o.fulfilment_type, o.status, (o.web_order_id IS NULL) AS no_order, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) orders, sum(f.net_amount) net, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE (s.store_id=900 OR o.web_order_id IS NOT NULL OR f.channel_code='WB' OR f.channel_id IS NOT NULL AND f.channel_id<>1) AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2026-01-31'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales, (p.category='ZZ Test') AS is_test
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id=900
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net, (p.category='ZZ Test')
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id=900
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_test THEN net_sales END),2) AS net_sales, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_test THEN net_sales END),2) AS test_net,
 (SELECT ROUND(SUM(r.net_sales),2) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d2 ON d2.calendar_date=r.business_date WHERE r.store_id=900 AND d2.fiscal_year=d.fiscal_year AND d2.fiscal_period=d.fiscal_period) AS control
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS net_sales
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE), f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id AND o.status IN ('delivered','collected')
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
) n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2
